page_title: WOL 2-2 NEW | Wolves v Newcastle 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+6' The foul by Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Anthony Taylor.
90+4' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends the corner into the box, but Jose Sa intercepts it and averts the threat.
90+3' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
90+3' The referee awards a corner and Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take it.
90+2' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+1' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Wolves are going to take it.
86' Here's the change. Mario Lemina leaves the pitch and Joao Gomes (Wolves) comes on as a substitute.

85' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Jose Sa pulls off a comfortable save.
83' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) sees a yellow card from Anthony Taylor after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
82' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) for a tough tackle.
81' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored!
78' The resulting set piece from Newcastle is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' Here is a change. Pedro Neto is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves).
75' Pedro Neto (Wolves) picks up an injury.
72' Substitution. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) has come on for Miguel Almiron.
71' 2 - 2 Goal - 2:2! Toti tees up Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Nick Pope.
69' Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Anthony Taylor didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
67' Pedro Neto (Wolves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nick Pope, who smothers the ball.
66' A yellow card for a tackle by Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd). Anthony Taylor doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
64' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
63' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) brings an opponent down and Anthony Taylor interrupts the game.
60' The corner kick from Pedro Neto (Wolves) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
58' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Wolves was in an offside position.
56' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
55' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nick Pope intercepts the ball.
54' We are about to witness a substitution. Thomas Doyle (Wolves) is replacing Boubacar Traore.
53' Mario Lemina (Wolves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Anthony Taylor signals.
52' Mario Lemina (Wolves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Anthony Taylor saw the whole situation.
48' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Pedro Neto (Wolves) on the edge of the box.
48' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. Wolves earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
47' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+8' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

45+7' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
45+7' Wolves couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
45+6' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) makes a slide tackle, but referee Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
45+5' 1 - 2 Goal! Jose Sa gets a hand on the penalty from Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd), but can't stop it from flying into the middle of the goal.
45+4' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+3' Referee Anthony Taylor is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Newcastle!
45+2' Celebrations by Newcastle are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
45+1' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Newcastle!!
45+1' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
44' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) makes a strong challenge and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
42' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
42' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Newcastle earn a corner.
41' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

41' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Newcastle.
38' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
36' 1 - 1 The score has changed – 1:1. Pedro Neto sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Mario Lemina (Wolves) jumps highest and plants a header inside the right post.
36' Pedro Neto (Wolves) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

36' A sweet pass finds Pedro Neto (Wolves) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Nick Pope is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolves.
35' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
32' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
30' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
29' A corner kick by Wolves is thwarted by the well prepared Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd).
27' The foul by Nelson Semedo (Wolves) was seen by Anthony Taylor who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
26' Great teamplay by Wolves as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
22' 0 - 1 GOAL! Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) gets to the rebound inside the box and fires in a stunning overhead kick. Phenomenal finish! 0:1.
20' The keeper makes a simple save after Matheus Cunha (Wolves) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
17' Neat passing move from Newcastle in order to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul and Anthony Taylor immediately signals a free kick.
9' Pedro Neto (Wolves) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

8' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
8' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
7' Pedro Neto (Wolves) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

6' Pedro Neto (Wolves) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
6' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner.
4' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post.
1' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The first half has started.
Newcastle will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Anthony Taylor.
